item.title: ABC News: Brisbane 2032 emblems leaked by official YouTube channel
item.description: The emblems for the Brisbane 2032 Olympics and Paralympics have been accidentally leaked by the Games' official YouTube channel, ruining its own a grand unveiling slated for Monday.

item.title: ABC News: Victoria is about to have the most unpredictable election in living memory
item.description: Much has been written about the rise of Pauline Hanson's One Nation in the past 12 months. The Victorian election will give us our best look yet at the decline of the two-party system.

item.title: ABC News: Man charged with preparing terrorist acts against Nigel Farage
item.description: Joshua Kerry had already been charged with the murder of former British MP Ann Widdecombe and has now been charged with preparing acts of terrorism.

item.title: ABC News: Geelong notch seventh-straight AFLW win as Scheer fires against Richmond
item.description: Geelong has climbed to the top of the AFLW ladder with a 34-point victory over Richmond at Princes Park.

item.title: ABC News: Qld's mostly sunny long weekend could descend into severe storms
item.description: Storms are expected across southern parts of Queensland during the long weekend, but conditions up north should ease for the public holiday.

item.title: ABC News: NY governor slams handling of Cornell 'gang-rape' case
item.description: Kathy Hochul says the woman who accused a group of Cornell University students of rape has been "failed" at "every turn" by authorities.

item.title: ABC News: Is a 'fantasy' now driving Australia's power reliability outlook?
item.description: Historically, forecasting power reliability was a sober task. Experts say Australia is now counting on projects that will never be built.

item.title: ABC News: G7 to release 100 million barrels of oil in bid to curb soaring prices
item.description: The announcement from French President Emmanuel Macron came after US President Donald Trump ramped up pressure on Europe to release reserves.

item.title: ABC News: Two artists from same remote community finalists in prestigious portrait prize
item.description: Students of generations of famous painters at Warmun's Art Centre, Dwayne Jessell and Troy Drill's unique Kimberley self-portraits are finalists at this year's Lester Prize.

item.title: ABC News: Greens see red-hot anger as an opportunity to take on Hanson, Labor
item.description: David Shoebridge has big ambitions for the Greens, but his party is still wrestling with how to turn voter disillusionment into greater support.

item.title: ABC News: A 'bent' needle and multiple doses: How a botched execution unfolded
item.description: Convicted killer Christa Pike remains in hospital receiving emergency treatment after surviving two doses of the lethal injection drug pentobarbital.

item.title: ABC News: Tedesco and Ponga went through different worlds to meet in NRL grand final
item.description: On Sunday, opposing fullbacks James Tedesco and Kalyn Ponga will lead their teams into the NRL grand final. It's about the only thing their paths have had in common.

item.title: ABC News: Switzerland's 'wake-up call' as glaciers melt in record-breaking summer
item.description: Europe's record-breaking summer has led to "staggering" melting on Switzerland's famous glaciers, according to a new report.

item.title: ABC News: Ivory still legal to sell in Australia despite 2019 promise to ban it
item.description: A new study has found hardly any of the $1.2 million worth of elephant ivory sold or advertised in a six-month period in Australia came with paperwork proving its origin.

item.title: ABC News: From prison to billionaire data centre operator, the incredible story of Oliver Curtis
item.description: He went to prison for insider trading but Oliver Curtis is about to be the source of one of Australia's largest share market floats.

item.title: ABC News: The evidence that drew a smile from accused murderer Beau Lamarre-Condon
item.description: For the bulk of his murder trial former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon has remained impassive, except for when his former friends have been on the stand testifying against him.

item.title: ABC News: Trump's 'excursion into hell' commentary may come back to bite
item.description: What so many of the current major global conflicts have in common with the debacle in Iraq is their undefined, or sometimes not truthfully defined, missions.

item.title: ABC News: ABC 50/50 quiz: Testing your knowledge of Kermit the Frog, Princess Diana and 90s TV principals
item.description: Each question in the ABC 50/50 quiz has only two options: one is right, the other is wrong. But be warned, we might try to trick you.
